passive.name: String & Melody
passive.text: CRIT DMG increases by **50/57.5/65/72.5/80%**. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, they gain 1 stack of **Heartstring**. Each stack of **Heartstring** allows the equipper's **Chain Attack** and **Ultimate** to ignore **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%** of the target's **Fire RES**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Tranquil Blossom
passive.text: CRIT DMG is increased by **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%**. When the equipper lands a hit with a **Basic Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **Aftershock**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's **Electric DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Sprouting Core
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **15/17/19/21/23%**. When the equipper deals DMG with a **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's **Electric DMG** by **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%**, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's **Basic Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG ignore **20/23/26/29/32%** of enemy DEF.

passive.name: Knight's Combo
passive.text: Launching a **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** increases the equipper's ATK by **12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2%** for 12s.

passive.name: Metal Cat Claws
passive.text: Increases **Physical DMG** by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The equipper's DMG increases by **25/31.5/38/44/50%** when hitting the enemy from behind.

substatLine: CRIT RATE > CRIT DMG = ATK% > PEN > ATK
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Special Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing **Physical DMG** and **Fire DMG**.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enter **Binding Seal**.

entries.name: Passive: Bind
entries.text:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate **Burning Embers**.
When Evelyn consumes **Burning Embers** to activate **Garrote** or consumes **Decibels** to perform an **Ultimate**, she gains 1 **Burning Tether Point**.
Once Evelyn has 3 **Burning Tether Points**, her next use of **Garrote** will consume all **Burning Tether Points** to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of **Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
entries.text:
When **Burning Embers** is at 50% or higher, hold Basic Attack or Special Attack to activate:
Consume 50% **Burning Embers** to use **Lunalux Garrote** to perform a slashing attack, dealing **Fire DMG**.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 **Burning Tether Point**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
entries.text:
When **Burning Embers** is 50% or higher, after using **Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form**, continue to hold Basic Attack or Special Attack to activate:
Consume 50% **Burning Embers** to use **Lunalux Garrote** to perform a follow-up attack, dealing **Fire DMG**.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 **Burning Tether Point**.

entries.name: Dodge: Arc Step
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Use **Lunalux Garrote** to slash surrounding enemies, dealing **Fire DMG**;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enter **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Fierce Blade
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Use **Lunalux Garrote** to slash surrounding enemies, dealing **Fire DMG**.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enter **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Silent Protection
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Evelyn slashes with **Lunalux Garrote**, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing **Fire DMG**.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enter **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Locked Position
entries.text:
Before entering **Binding Seal**, press Special Attack or EX Special Attack to activate:
Use **Lunalux Garrote** to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing **Fire DMG**.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enter **Binding Seal**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form
entries.text:
After entering **Binding Seal**, press or hold Special Attack to activate:
Centered on the target affected by **Binding Seal**, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing **Fire DMG**. **Binding Seal** will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered, gain an additional 25% **Burning Embers**.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press Basic Attack to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the **Basic Attack's** 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
entries.text:
After entering **Binding Seal** and with enough Energy, press or hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Centered on the target affected by **Binding Seal**, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive **Fire DMG**. **Binding Seal** will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered, gain an additional 25% **Burning Embers**.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press Basic Attack to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the **Basic Attack's** 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple **Lunalux Garrotes** and detonates an explosion, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enters **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple **Lunalux Garrotes** and detonates an explosion, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the **Dance of Awakened Fire** state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the **Dance of Awakened Fire** state, when Evelyn consumes **Burning Tether Points** to activate **Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare**, she will retain 1 point of **Burning Tether Point**. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target, entering **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 **Burning Tether Point**.

entries.name: Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
entries.text:
While under the **Dance of Awakened Fire** state, and when Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple **Lunalux Garrotes** and detonates an explosion, dealing massive **Fire DMG** to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses **Lunalux Garrote** to bind the primary target and enters **Binding Seal**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 **Burning Tether Point**.

entries.name: Core Passive: Entangle
entries.text: Upon entering **Binding Seal**, Evelyn's CRIT Rate increases by **25%**. After leaving **Binding Seal**, she retains the buff for 10s. If Evelyn switches to another character while in **Binding Seal**, she will automatically follow up with **Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Ambush Point
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun** or **Support** character:
Evelyn's **Chain Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's CRIT Rate is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her **Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare**, **Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre** and **Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow** increases to 125% of the original value.

entries.name: Dreamweave
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode.
Enemies affected by **Binding Seal** will be **Bound**. When Evelyn attacks **Bound** enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF.
When Evelyn uses **Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form** or **EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form**, the **Bound** effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread **Bound** effect lasts for 10s.

entries.name: Dance of Fire
entries.text:
Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%.
When Evelyn uses **Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form** or **Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form**, the **Burning Embers** consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s.
When Evelyn consumes **Burning Tether Point** to trigger **Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare**, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

entries.name: Metamorphosis
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Fate's Melody
entries.text: Upon activating a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

entries.name: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Bond of Light and Shadow
entries.text:
Upon launching a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, Evelyn gains **Shadowstring Edge** for 20s.
During **Shadowstring Edge**, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a **Basic Attack**, **Dash Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **EX Special Attack**, she additionally executes a **Lunalux Garrote** follow-up attack, dealing **Fire DMG** equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area.
This DMG is considered **Chain Attack** DMG and can trigger up to 16 times.
Gaining another **Shadowstring Edge** will refresh the trigger count.
